notes: Direct permissive Decred secp256k1 ECDSA vectors. The upstream signing vectors state that the key, digest, nonce, r, and s values were independently verified with Sage. Selected RFC 6979 cases were transformed to fixed-width r||s and canonical DER. Selected malformed DER cases are verbatim hex. No Open BSV Go SDK source, fixture, or oracle output is included.

files.transformation: Selected two RFC6979 signTests and nine strict DER rejection cases. Concatenated each 32-byte r and s as compact form and encoded those same integers in canonical DER; represented all bytes as lowercase hexadecimal JSON strings.
